newsitem.title: CANADA: Russel Metals, Paros agree on directors.
newsitem.headline: Russel Metals, Paros agree on directors.

text.p: Russel Metals Inc said on Wednesday it reached an agreement with hostile shareholder Paros Enterprises Ltd under which Russel and Paros agreed to vote in favor of a jointly nominated slate of directors at this afternoon's annual meeting.

Russel said it had a number of meetings and discussions with Paros and with a number of Russel shareholders after the filing by Paros of a dissident proxy circular nominating its own slate of directors to Russel's Board.

"It is clear to everyone that an amicable agreement on a slate of directors is in the best interests of Russel Metals and its shareholders. We are pleased to have reached an agreement prior to today's annual meeting," the two parties said in a joint statement.
Russel said Chairman and Chief Executive John Pelton would tender his resignation as chief executive after the annual meeting.
Paros is the personal investment company of Rai Sahi, who also owns a 26 percent stake in Acklands Ltd, where he is chairman and chief executive.
Russel said the newly elected board would select from its members a new chairman and it would initiate a selection process to choose a new chief executive.
Edward Siegel, currently executive vice-president and chief operating office (metals), would act as chief executive in the interim, Russel said.
